title: Back in the Old Country
question: Did the narrator find his mother's grave?

meanings.usage: 形容对某人来说不熟悉、格格不入的事物
指来自其他国家的人或生物
用于描述非常悲伤、令人痛心的事件或情况
指从本国移居到另一个国家，强调离开的动作
be absorbed in表示专注于某事，沉迷其中
指因失去某人或某事而感到悲伤和痛苦
修饰形容词或动词，表示达到致死的程度
字面意思是道路上的里程标记，比喻人生或历史上的重要阶段
表示对某事非常有把握、确定无疑
通常指教堂或塔楼顶部的尖形结构
指将某物置于水面以下，或被水覆盖
指人工建造的用于储水的水体
指乡村的小房子，通常只有一层或两层
指收回说过的话或采取的行动，也可指缩回
指令人恐惧或痛苦的梦，也比喻可怕的经历
指快速地看一眼，强调动作的短暂性

examples.en: I stopped to let the car cool off.
examples.zh: 我停下来让汽车冷却下来。

examples.en: He became absorbed in making a new life for the two of us.
examples.zh: 他全神贯注地为我们俩创造新生活。

examples.en: I lacked for nothing, for he was both father and mother to me.
examples.zh: 我什么都不缺，因为他既当父亲又当母亲。

examples.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
examples.zh: 我认定我一定是某个地方拐错弯了。

examples.en: The spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance.
examples.zh: 我们村庄教堂的尖顶在远处显现出来。

examples.en: There was nobody in sight to help me.
examples.zh: 看不到有任何人在场能帮我。

examples.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
examples.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下来。

examples.en: He made me promise to go on my own.
examples.zh: 他让我答应独自去。

examples.en: As I was wondering what to do next, a man appeared.
examples.zh: 正当我在想下一步该怎么办时，一个人出现了。

examples.en: This time he pointed to the lake.
examples.zh: 这次他指向了那个湖。

sentences.en: I stopped to let the car cool off and to study the map.
sentences.zh: 我停车让车冷却下来，并研究地图。

sentences.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now, but everything still seemed alien to me.
sentences.zh: 我本以为现在应该离目的地很近了，但周围的一切对我来说仍然很陌生。

sentences.en: I was only five when my father had taken me abroad, and that was eighteen years ago.
sentences.zh: 我父亲带我出国时我才五岁，那已经是十八年前的事了。

sentences.en: When my mother had died after a tragic accident, he did not quickly recover from the shock and loneliness.
sentences.zh: 母亲在一场悲惨的事故中去世后，他未能很快从震惊和孤独中恢复过来。

sentences.en: Everything around him was full of her presence, continually reopening the wound.
sentences.zh: 他周围的一切都充满了她的气息，不断地撕开他的伤口。

sentences.en: So he decided to emigrate.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定移民。

sentences.en: In the new country he became absorbed in making a new life for the two of us, so that he gradually ceased to grieve.
sentences.zh: 在新的国家，他全心投入为我们俩创造新生活，于是他渐渐停止了悲伤。

sentences.en: He did not marry again and I was brought up without a woman's care; but I lacked for nothing, for he was both father and mother to me.
sentences.zh: 他没有再婚，我是在没有女性关爱的情况下长大的；但我什么都不缺，因为他既是我的父亲也是我的母亲。

sentences.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
sentences.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下。

sentences.en: His roots and mine had become too firmly embedded in the new land.
sentences.zh: 他和我的根基都已在新土地上扎得太深了。

sentences.en: But he wanted to see the old folk again and to visit my mother's grave.
sentences.zh: 但他想再见见老乡们，并去我母亲的坟墓看看。

sentences.en: He became mortally ill a few months before we had planned to go and, when he knew that he was dying, he made me promise to go on my own.
sentences.zh: 在我们计划动身前的几个月，他得了绝症，当他知道自己快要去世时，他让我答应独自前往。

sentences.en: I hired a car the day after landing and bought a comprehensive book of maps,
sentences.zh: 降落的第二天，我租了一辆车，买了一本详尽的地图册，

sentences.en: which I found most helpful on the cross-country journey, but which I did not think I should need on the last stage.
sentences.zh: 我发现这本地图册在跨国旅途中非常有用，但我不认为在最后一段路程中我还需要它。

sentences.en: It was not that I actually remembered anything at all.
sentences.zh: 并不是我真的记得任何东西。

sentences.en: But my father had described over and over again what we should see at every milestone after leaving the nearest town,
sentences.zh: 但父亲曾一遍又一遍地描述，离开最近的城镇后，每过一个里程碑我们会看到什么，

sentences.en: so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory.
sentences.zh: 所以我确信我会认出那是熟悉的土地。

sentences.en: Well, I had been wrong, for I was now lost.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我错了，因为我现在迷路了。

sentences.en: I looked at the map and then at the milometer.
sentences.zh: 我看了看地图，然后看了看里程表。

sentences.en: I had come ten miles since leaving the town and at this point, according to my father,
sentences.zh: 我离开城镇已经走了十英里，按照我父亲的说法，在这个地方，

sentences.en: I should be looking at farms and cottages in a valley,
sentences.zh: 我应该能看到山谷里的农场和小屋，

sentences.en: with the spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance.
sentences.zh: 远处还能看到我们村教堂的尖顶。

sentences.en: I could see no valley, no farms, no cottages and no church spire-only a lake.
sentences.zh: 我看不到山谷，看不到农场，看不到小屋，也看不到教堂尖顶——只有一片湖。

sentences.en: I decided that I must have taken a wrong turning somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我断定我一定是在某个地方拐错了弯。

sentences.en: So I drove back to the town and began to retrace the route, taking frequent glances at the map.
sentences.zh: 于是我开车回到城镇，开始按原路返回，并不时地看一眼地图。

sentences.en: I landed up at the same corner.
sentences.zh: 我最终还是回到了同一个路口。

sentences.en: The curious thing was that the lake was not marked on the map.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，地图上并没有标示这片湖。

sentences.en: I felt as if I had stumbled into a nightmare country, as you sometimes do in dreams.
sentences.zh: 我感觉自己好像偶然闯入了一个噩梦般的国度，就像你在梦中有时会遇到的那样。

sentences.en: And, as in a nightmare, there was nobody in sight to help me.
sentences.zh: 就像在噩梦中一样，四周没有人能帮助我。

sentences.en: Fortunately for me, as I was wondering what to do next,
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，正当我不知下一步该怎么办的时候，

sentences.en: there appeared on the horizon a man on horseback, riding in my direction.
sentences.zh: 地平线上出现了一位骑马的人，正朝我这个方向骑来。

sentences.en: I waited till he came near, then I asked him the way to our old village.
sentences.zh: 我等到他走近，然后问他去我们那个老村子的路。

sentences.en: He said that there was now no village.
sentences.zh: 他说现在已经没有那个村子了。

sentences.en: I thought he must have misunderstood me, so I repeated its name.
sentences.zh: 我以为他一定是误解了我的意思，所以我又重复了一遍村子的名字。

sentences.en: This time he pointed to the lake.
sentences.zh: 这次他指向了湖面。

sentences.en: The village no longer existed because it had been submerged, and all the valley too.
sentences.zh: 那个村子已经不复存在了，因为它连同整个山谷都被淹没了。

sentences.en: The lake was not a natural one, but a man-made reservoir.
sentences.zh: 那片湖不是天然形成的，而是一个人工水库。

exercises.prompt: “used to表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，常含有与现在对比的意味；would只表示过去反复发生的动作，不表示状态” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: used to + 动词原形 / would + 动词原形
options: used to 与 would 的区别
过去完成时被动态 (Past Perfect Passive)
虚拟语气 (Subjunctive Mood) - 与现在事实相反
exercises.explain: used to 与 would 的区别：used to + 动词原形 / would + 动词原形：used to可以表示"曾经是"（状态）或"过去常常"（动作），而would只用于重复的动作。

source.title: used to 与 would 的区别

我重新组装好机器后，发现它仍然无法工作，对此我并不感到惊讶，
exercises.explain: Well, I had been wrong, for I was now lost. — 嗯，我错了，因为我现在迷路了。

source.en: Well, I had been wrong, for I was now lost.

grammar.title: 过去完成时（Past Perfect Tense）
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作或状态，即"过去的过去"
grammar.usage: 当叙述过去发生的事件时，需要表示更早发生的动作或情况时使用。常与by the time, before, after等连用，或用于宾语从句中表示过去的过去。

examples.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now.
examples.zh: 我原本以为现在已经接近目的地了。

examples.en: I was only five when my father had taken me abroad.
examples.zh: 我父亲带我出国时我只有五岁。

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时（Past Perfect Continuous）
grammar.definition: 表示过去某个时间之前一直在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 强调动作的持续性和进行过程，常与for或since连用。

examples.en: He had been describing over and over again what we should see.
examples.zh: 他曾一遍又一遍地描述我们会看到什么。

grammar.title: used to 与 would 的区别
grammar.definition: used to表示过去的习惯性动作或状态，常含有与现在对比的意味；would只表示过去反复发生的动作，不表示状态
grammar.structure: used to + 动词原形 / would + 动词原形
grammar.usage: used to可以表示"曾经是"（状态）或"过去常常"（动作），而would只用于重复的动作。

examples.en: He always meant to go back one day, but not to stay.
examples.zh: 他一直打算有一天回去，但不是为了留下来。

examples.en: My father had described over and over again what we should see.
examples.zh: 我父亲曾一遍又一遍地描述我们会看到什么。

patterns.pattern: I had expected to + 动词原形, but...

original.en: I had expected to be near my objective by now, but everything still seemed alien to me.
original.zh: 我原本以为现在已经接近目的地了，但一切对我来说仍然很陌生。

examples.en: I had expected to finish the work on time, but I ran out of time.
examples.zh: 我原本以为能按时完成工作，但我时间不够了。

examples.en: She had expected to meet him at the station, but he never came.
examples.zh: 她原本以为会在车站见到他，但他根本没来。

original.en: It was not that I actually remembered anything at all. But my father had described over and over again...
original.zh: 并不是我真的记得什么。而是我父亲曾一遍又一遍地描述……

examples.en: It was not that she didn't want to help, but she really had no time.
examples.zh: 并不是她不想帮忙，而是她真的没有时间。

examples.en: It was not that he was lazy, but he simply didn't know how to start.
examples.zh: 并不是他懒惰，而是他根本不知道如何开始。

original.en: The curious thing was that the lake was not marked on the map.
original.zh: 奇怪的是那个湖在地图上并没有标注。

examples.en: The curious thing was that he knew the answer but refused to tell.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是他知道答案却不肯说。

examples.en: The curious thing was that the door was open but nobody was inside.
examples.zh: 奇怪的是门开着但里面没有人。

original.en: The village no longer existed because it had been submerged.
original.zh: 那个村庄不再存在了，因为它已经被淹没了。

examples.en: He no longer lives in this city.
examples.zh: 他不再住在这个城市了。

examples.en: This factory no longer produces plastic bags.
examples.zh: 这家工厂不再生产塑料袋了。
